name: COLD GAS
tagline: Ten thrusters. One roll. Stick the landing.

capture.notes: Real frames from a Debug build of main on 2026-11-19 (1.2.0 with 0292's redrawn vehicles: our own roadster, lineup and launch site; the 2026-11-16 set showed the retired wedge car and lattice rocket, which 0292 replaced as an IP risk), shot with -mute -uitest on one-off simulators, one at a time, deleted after: the reference Show on Assist and the scripted carry-5 wreck frozen at a tick (-play -autopilot -course show -freeze 2700 / 3400; -play -script crash-show-carry5 -freeze 3480, the car kicked off the row's end), the results after a whole run, the guided first jump (-firstrun -play -freeze 1300), Free Drive 3 km out (-freedrive -fd-km 3 -fd-cruise 25), a challenge link opened in the app (-open), Advanced's valve deck (-tier advanced -freeze 2700), the layout editor (-hudEdit assist), and the Duo in tabletop (-window 669x951 -pose tabletop). The iPhone and Duo simulators have no Apple Intelligence (their receipt names the game's own words); the iPad's says Judged on device. No caption claims either. 6.9-inch iPhone 18 Pro Max for raw-1.2.0/iphone, 13-inch iPad Pro (M5) for raw-1.2.0/ipad, the Duo's outer display for raw-1.2.0/duo. raw/ keeps 1.1.0's frames.

shots.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
shots.sub: Ten cold-gas thrusters. One mark to land on.

shots.title: Or *wreck it.*
shots.sub: Miss the mark and the physics decides how it comes down.

shots.title: Every number, *explained.*
shots.sub: A fixed scorer sets the score. The judges say why, and what to fly next.

shots.title: Your first jump *teaches itself.*
shots.sub: One tap to fly. One hint at each beat.

shots.title: Then just *drive.*
shots.sub: Off the apron into a world built as you go. No timer, no score.

shots.title: Beat *their* score.
shots.sub: A friend's link opens the app on their jump.

shots.title: Feel *every wheel* land.
shots.sub: A synced landing is one thump. A sloppy one is four.

shots.title: Fly *ten valves* by hand.
shots.sub: Assist, Pro, Advanced: take the computer away one tier at a time.

shots.title: Every control *where your thumbs are.*
shots.sub: Drag, resize and fade each one, for each way you hold the screen.

shots.title: A console *in tabletop.*
shots.sub: Half open: the scene on the top screen, the controller on the bottom.

feature.title: Clear the row. *Stick it.*
feature.sub: Ten thrusters. One roll. Three judges.
